nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding token decimals (18).
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' storing token balances of holders.
Nested mapping 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>amount.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, total supply and assigning all tokens to msg.sender.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returns the balances mapping entry for the owner.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) returns the allowed mapping entry.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) writes the allowance of msg.sender for spender and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens using the allowance; no explicit allowance sufficiency check before spending.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) performs c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) performs c = a - b with require(b <= a) underflow check.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) performs c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) performs c = a / b with require(b > 0) division-by-zero check.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used in constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() not routed through SafeMath.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd, potential arithmetic overflow guarded only by an assertion-like require.
Subtraction c = a - b in safeSub, potential arithmetic underflow guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul, potential arithmetic overflow guarded by division check.
Division c = a / b in safeDiv, potential division-by-zero guarded by require(b > 0).
transferFrom spends the allowance without verifying allowed[from][msg.sender] >= tokens, an access-control weakness in the standard ERC20 flow.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender in transferFrom and its allowance is debited without a sufficiency check.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor sets name = 'Ashpicachu'.
Constructor sets symbol = 'ASH'.
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply feeds _totalSupply and balances[address(0)] into an unchecked subtraction.
approve writes tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer passes balances[msg.sender] and tokens to safeSub.
transfer passes balances[to] and tokens to safeAdd.
transfer updates sender and recipient entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom passes balances[from] and tokens to safeSub.
transferFrom passes balances[to] and tokens to safeAdd.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking it is sufficient.
transferFrom reaches the state-mutating transfer path without a prior allowance sufficiency check.

safeMul executes the a * b multiplication that can overflow.
safeDiv executes the a / b division that can divide by zero.
